Module it.polimi.ingsw

Class GameSettingsSceneController

java.lang.Object
javafx.application.Application
it.polimi.ingsw.View.GUI.Gui
it.polimi.ingsw.View.GUI.GameSettingsSceneController
All Implemented Interfaces:
javafx.fxml.Initializable
public class GameSettingsSceneController extends Gui implements javafx.fxml.Initializable
Controller for the game settings scene in the GUI. This class handles the user interactions in the game settings scene where players can choose to start a new game or join an existing one, and select the number of players for the game.

  • Method Details

    • getSelectedNumberOfPlayersOption

      public int getSelectedNumberOfPlayersOption()
      Gets the number of players selected by the user.
      Returns:
      The number of players selected (2, 3, or 4). Returns 0 if no option is selected.

    • onContinueButton

      public void onContinueButton(javafx.event.ActionEvent event)
      Handles the action when the continue button is clicked. Based on the selected game option (new game or join game), it sends the appropriate message to the server and switches to the respective scene.
      Parameters:
      event - The action event triggered by the continue button.

    • initialize

      public void initialize(URL url, ResourceBundle resourceBundle)
      Initializes the controller class. This method is automatically called after the FXML file has been loaded. It sets up the initial state of the controls and adds listeners to the toggle groups to enable the continue button only when both game option and player number are selected.
      Specified by:
      initialize in interface javafx.fxml.Initializable
      Parameters:
      url - The location used to resolve relative paths for the root object, or null if the location is not known.
      resourceBundle - The resources used to localize the root object, or null if the root object was not localized.
